Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: After being instructed to find and verify the director’s place of death using reliable sources, WebSurfer only reported search engine snippets and did not open or read the actual source pages (e.g., IMDb, Wikipedia) to extract and confirm the information. This reliance on contradictory SERP summaries (e.g., Montagnana vs. Rome) and failure to verify on-page details prevented resolving the discrepancy and led to no correct final answer (Rome, Lazio, Italy).
